name: Nevatech Sentinet
description_en:
Nevatech Sentinet manages REST APIs and SOAP services through virtual facades hosted on gateway nodes. Administrators register APIs in a central catalog, design the consumer-facing facade and distribute configuration to nodes. Consumers call that facade while the gateway routes to the actual business API and reports usage back to the catalog.

The reviewed 6.7 documentation separates runtime nodes, the management application, repository storage and an optional developer portal. This is deployed API-management infrastructure, not a promise that signing up creates a fully managed public cloud. Price and actual commercial entitlement remain independently unverified.
description_zh:
Nevatech Sentinet 通过网关节点上的虚拟门面管理 REST API 和 SOAP 服务。管理员在中央目录登记 API，设计面向调用方的门面并分发节点配置；调用方访问门面，网关路由到真实业务 API，再将用量送回目录。

实读 6.7 文档区分运行节点、管理应用、仓库存储及可选开发者门户。这是需部署的 API 管理基础设施，不代表注册即得到完整托管公有云；价格和实际商业权益保持独立未核实。

core_features.explanation_en: Gateways host dynamically configured facade endpoints in front of business APIs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网关在业务 API 前提供动态配置的门面端点。

core_features.explanation_en: The SQL-backed repository stores API assets, configuration and monitoring information.
core_features.explanation_zh: SQL 仓库存储 API 资产、配置及监控信息。

core_features.explanation_en: The API exposes license type, enabled premium features and optional expiration.
core_features.explanation_zh: API 描述许可类型、启用的高级功能及可选到期时间。

sections.title_en: Trace the consumer and backend legs separately
sections.title_zh: 分别跟踪调用方与后端两段
sections.en: The documented sequence is catalog publication, facade design, node configuration, consumer request, backend forwarding and usage reporting. A facade can apply routing, security mediation and transformations. Evaluate a harmless backend with one allowed and one rejected request, and distinguish gateway rejection from a backend failure. No request or policy was executed here.
sections.zh: 文档流程为目录发布、门面设计、节点配置、调用方请求、后端转发及用量上报。门面可施加路由、安全介入与转换。应使用无害后端比较允许和拒绝请求，区分网关拒绝与后端失败；本次未执行请求或策略。

sections.title_en: Runtime nodes and the portal are different components
sections.title_zh: 运行节点与门户是不同组件
sections.en: Sentinet nodes are .NET proxy applications hosted in IIS. The management application connects to an on-premises/cloud SQL Server or Azure SQL repository. The optional developer portal adds API discovery, subscription requests and key-management experiences through Umbraco. Confirm each required component and its network/storage dependencies; the portal is not a substitute for a runtime gateway.
sections.zh: Sentinet 节点是 IIS 中的 .NET 代理应用；管理应用连接本地／云 SQL Server 或 Azure SQL 仓库。可选开发者门户通过 Umbraco 提供 API 发现、订阅请求及 key 管理体验。应逐一确认组件和网络／存储依赖，门户不能替代运行网关。

sections.title_zh: 有意识地使用 6.7 兼容矩阵
sections.en: The 6.7 matrix lists Windows clients/servers and SQL Server editions/versions, explicitly limiting SQL Express to nonproduction. It gives2 GB minimum and4 GB recommended memory. These are vendor prerequisites rather than a capacity plan or an endorsement of old operating-system security support. Match the actual supported stack and expected traffic before a production design.
sections.zh: 6.7 矩阵列 Windows 客户端／服务器及 SQL Server 版本，明确 SQL Express 仅非生产；内存最低 2GB、推荐 4GB。这些是厂商前提，不是容量规划，也不证明旧系统仍受安全支持。生产设计前应核对实际支持栈及流量。

sections.title_en: A license-information object is not a purchase offer
sections.title_zh: 许可信息对象不等于购买权益
sections.en: The 6.7 LicenseInfo API describes evaluation/development/nonproduction/production types, enabled premium features and an expiration property; a missing expiration denotes perpetual licensing in that object. This explains metadata only. It does not establish a particular customer’s grant, a trial duration, pricing, support coverage or the right to deploy another node.
sections.zh: 6.7 LicenseInfo API 描述评估／开发／非生产／生产类型、高级功能和到期属性，该对象无到期值表示永久许可。这仅解释元数据，不证明具体客户的权益、试用时长、价格、支持范围或增加节点的许可。
